tagline: International representation body for inland waterway transport, insurance and ship classification
hero_kpi_rationale: Key indicator of sector influence and engagement. The annual congress with 225 participants from 11 countries reflects the mobilization of major European inland navigation stakeholders and underscores the association's role as an international representation platform.

kpis.name: Annual Congress Participants
kpis.explanation: Total participants at the annual IVR Congress representing inland shipping, insurance and ship classification sectors across European countries.
kpis.description: The IVR organizes an annual congress bringing together key players from inland navigation, insurance and ship classification. This participation reflects sector engagement and the association's central role as a platform for international representation and exchange.
kpis.signal: 225 participants from 11 European countries at Frankfurt Congress May 2024

kpis.name: Number of Member Countries
kpis.explanation: Number of European countries represented through national member organizations in shipping, insurance and ship classification sectors.
kpis.description: The IVR brings together national representatives from 11 European countries covering inland navigation, insurance and ship classification sectors, illustrating its pan-European scope and international representation capacity.
kpis.signal: Represented by national representatives from 11 European countries at Frankfurt Congress May 2024

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Participants
kpis.explanation: Total participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium representing insurers, brokers, claims adjusters, shipping companies and legal experts.
kpis.description: The IVR's first Loss Prevention Colloquium in November 2024 in Antwerp brought together 80 professionals covering technical and financial aspects of incident prevention in European inland navigation. This inaugural event marks a new initiative to strengthen sector knowledge exchange.
kpis.signal: 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands and Germany at inaugural November 2024 event in Antwerp

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or advanced digital technologies related to AI in the 2024 annual report. The organization focuses on regulation, safety, loss prevention and sector representation.
